record.capability: Calc segment tree span conversions and numerical span values
gaps: Native comparison covers numerical keys with boolean and integer values through all original overloads: 256 boolean patterns and 64 numerical owners. The current shared mdds value contract admits boolean/number only. Custom native bool conversion, object or move-only value types, non-numerical key types, arbitrary template consumers, allocation/ABI and malformed/dangling states remain unverified. Complete ColumnSpanSet scan/action owners and browser consumers remain unimplemented; finite evidence does not establish whole-module parity.
